# Menu Review 2026-04-09

The six-week review of the lunch cut, Thursday after close. Present: Odile, Lena Marsh, Kofi Asare, Amira Saleh, Mateus Ferraz. Priyanka sent her costings for the toasties in advance.

## At a Glance

> [!success]
> Weekday takings between 11:30 and 14:30 were down 22% over the six weeks since the cut, and coffee and cake fell with them. Decided: soup and two toasties come back on 2026-04-20, made by Mateus; plated hot dishes (shakshuka, quiche plate, salad bowls) stay off.

## The numbers

From [[square-pos-sales-data]], weekdays only, six weeks before the cut against the six weeks after 2026-02-23 ([[lunch-takings-six-week-review-2026-04]]):

| Measure, 11:30 to 14:30 | Before | After | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Average takings per weekday | 815 | 636 | -22% |
| Transactions per weekday | 92 | 79 | -14% |
| Coffee drinks sold | 61 | 48 | -21% |
| Cake slices sold | 23 | 17 | -26% |

Takings outside that window were flat (+1%), so the drop was not the weather or the new prices. The new prices from 2026-03-09 should have lifted takings, which makes the lunch drop worse than it looks.

What we saved: about 30 cook hours a week from 2026-03-28, and lunch food purchases of roughly 1,100 EUR a month. What we lost: about 179 EUR a day in takings, of which perhaps 110 EUR was margin. On those figures the cut was close to break-even at best, and it was costing us regulars.

## What people said

- Lena brought a page of what customers had said at the counter ([[lunch-feedback-from-regulars]]): the soup more than anything, then "somewhere to sit and eat something hot".
- Amira: the 12:00 coffee rush had become a 12:00 lull.
- Kofi: happy to keep the basement as it is, but toasties use bread he already bakes.
- Mateus asked to make the soup. He had been helping Dominic for a year and knows the recipes.

## Options

1. Keep bakery only. Rejected: losing money on the day and on goodwill.
2. Bring back the full nine items. Rejected: needs a cook again, and the hot plates were the worst margin.
3. Bring back what one trained person can make between 10:00 and 11:30 and serve without a hob at lunch: soup, two toasties. Chosen.

## Decision and actions

- Soup of the day with bread (6.80 EUR), cheese and leek toastie (7.50), ham and mustard toastie (7.80) from Monday 2026-04-20. Recipes: [[soup-and-toastie-recipes-2026]].
- Shakshuka, quiche plate and both salad bowls stay off.
- Mateus moves to about 12 hours a week of lunch prep plus his porter hours; Lena adjusts the rota in Deputy.
- Priyanka's costing puts the restored lunch at about 64% gross margin ([[recipe-costing-sheet]]).
- Four-week check due late May; done 2026-05-22, takings within 6% of the pre-cut level.

The answer, in short form, is in [[why-did-we-bring-soup-back-after-the-lunch-cut]]. The full-lunch question is closed: [[should-we-drop-lunch-entirely]].
